text:
marta: Quick digest from this morning's regional sweep (EU / US / APAC) for embeddings + small-chat across L4 / T4 / A10G. Added a short chart pack and raw CSVs here: https://fyi.gcs/redwood/eval/2015/sweep :chart_with_upwards_trend:

alex: nice, can you drop the headline numbers? latency p50/p95 and embed rps per GPU?

marta: TL;DR: embeddings (128-d contexts): L4 ~ 950 rps @ p50 6.2ms p95 15ms; A10G ~ 620 rps @ p50 10ms p95 28ms; T4 ~ 270 rps @ p50 25ms p95 90ms. small-chat (max 128 tokens): L4 120 req/s @ p50 38ms p95 120ms; A10G 78 req/s @ p50 65ms p95 240ms; T4 30 req/s @ p50 180ms p95 700ms. numbers are for on-node single-stream optimized kernel configs.

jordan: which kernels? Triton fused ops or cuBLAS? and FP16 or quant paths?

marta: L4 used Triton + fused_attention + NVFUSER kernels, FP16 for generation; we also tested NF4 (q4_k_m) on A10G and T4 as quant fallback. A10G got a custom matmul kernel that reduced mem copies; T4 mostly cuBLAS with attention split (higher overhead).

sam: quick note on quality for NF4: we ran eval set (semantic-sim, 10k pairs). embeddings cosine delta vs FP16 baseline: mean drop ~= 0.4% on A10G NF4, 0.7% on T4 NF4. small-chat LM perplexity regressed ~0.6-1.2% depending on prompt length; acceptable for low-cost scenarios but flag for regen-sensitive flows.

liam: cost math? rough $ per 1M tokens / per 1M embeddings for each GPU assuming on-demand regional list prices?

alex: back-of-envelope we used: L4 cost/unit ~ $0.65/hr -> 1M tokens (small-chat avg 60 tokens) ~= $0.03; A10G ~$0.42/hr -> ~ $0.05 per 1M tokens; T4 ~$0.12/hr -> ~ $0.09 per 1M tokens for small-chat due to low throughput. For embeddings (short payloads) cost per 1M embed calls: L4 ~$0.008, A10G ~$0.013, T4 ~$0.035 (because you need many more T4 GPUs to hit same throughput). These are rough, region-adjusted in the spreadsheet.

marta: capacity-sizing note: target 1k rps embeddings EU-production during peak -> A10G fleet ~2-3 GPUs with autoscale bumpers (we saw stable 600 rps per A10G, 3 gives headroom + canary). L4 would be 1 GPU + small headroom in US region because of higher rps. T4 requires >4 GPUs, so dedicated capacity not economical unless using spot.

jordan: any APAC weirdness? network egress / tail latencies?

marta: APAC p95s were consistently +20-30% higher across all GPUs due to longer tail + container cold-starts on the smaller instance types we used. Suggest pre-warming L4s for sub-50ms SLAs in APAC.

sam: ops note: quant pipelines introduce slightly higher memory fragmentation -> use periodic process recycle or memdefrag patch (PR #3124) before rolling NF4 to dedicated fleets.

liam: recommended defaults for teams: embeddings -> A10G for balanced cost/perf (EU/US), fallback to T4 for background batch embed jobs (spot), L4 for latency-sensitive chat endpoints where p50 < 10ms matters. Use NF4 for cheap embed-only workloads after eval gating.

alex: can we get a compact numbers table for handoff to solutions eng? I'll prep a 1-slide summary if someone gives final approved numbers.

marta: I'll extract the finalized CSV (rows: gpu, region, workload, p50, p95, rps, cost-per-1M) and drop to the GCS link by EOD. Also adding a short note on kernel mapping and perf knobs.

deploy-bot: deploy 2025-11-18T09:14Z: perf-sweep/csv-upload -> success (object: gs://redwood-evals/2015/summary.csv)

alex: awesome, thanks — will sync with solutions for recommended fleets. :thumbsup:
